implementationReview.area: Authenticated fixed operation and bounded contract
observations: meter.snapshot accepts only null payload; clients cannot select PID, filesystem, cadence, history or attribution. Existing same-user admission, authenticated exchange_until, request correlation, protocol 1 and absolute deadlines remain in use.

Cached reads run neither native probes nor SQL. Result size is at most 16,384 bytes. Rust and TypeScript validate exact object shapes, finite/safe numbers, units, timestamps, identities and bounded UTF-8 diagnostics.

Available/first_interval/unsupported/denied/failed are distinct. Only host CPU can be first_interval. Missing values never become numeric zero. CLI failure exits nonzero without fabricated JSON; raw peer diagnostics are not displayed.

implementationReview.area: Host CPU interval, normalization, reset/wrap and clocks
observations: HOST_CPU_LOAD_INFO supplies cumulative user/system/nice/idle counters with native width 32 and logical CPU topology. Busy delta / total delta * 100 already represents whole-host capacity; no second core divisor is applied.

Available CPU carries nullable UTC endpoints, monotonic endpoints, elapsed milliseconds, logical CPU count and host_capacity normalization. First sample and topology changes remain first_interval; wall-clock changes affect labels only.

Native failure clears the baseline. Zero delta, implausible jumps, clock anomalies, resets and long ambiguous gaps remain unknown. Legitimate wraps require plausible boundary windows; half-range ambiguity applies even to increasing endpoints after a complete wrap.
Executed cases include 8/32/64-bit boundaries, the 50-day/12-core hidden-wrap regression, independent wall/monotonic changes and recovery after CPU failure.

implementationReview.area: RAM, native memory pressure, swap and filesystem
observations: Available RAM is the declared Darwin estimate (free_count + inactive_count) * page size. Speculative pages are not added again; compressed/purgeable overlap is excluded. UI describes the definition rather than claiming guaranteed allocation or Activity Monitor's used-memory complement.
Native pressure uses kern.memorystatus_vm_pressure_level flags 1/2/4 mapped to normal/warning/critical. Swap is native xsu_used bytes, not capacity or process consumption.

statfs(/) identifies a local absolute path/mount, filesystem type and volume ID. Capacity/free/caller-available bytes are separate native fields with ordering and safe integer checks. APFS semantics are disclosed.

Disk pressure is separately derived from available/capacity with 5% and 10% thresholds. Missing/zero capacity makes the judgment unknown. Per-field failures preserve working fields. Mach host send rights are released and native diagnostics stay local/bounded.
implementationReview.scope: Host totals are not job/vendor attribution, disk writes, reclaimed bytes, worktree footprint or savings.

implementationReview.area: Daemon-only cumulative CPU, current RSS and observed sampled peak
observations: getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF) supplies cumulative user+system core-seconds for this daemon, excluding children and core normalization. Invalid/regressing cumulative time remains failed.
PROC_PIDTASKINFO.pti_resident_size supplies current RSS bytes; ru_maxrss and physical footprint are not substituted.

Observed peak is a derived running maximum of successful RSS samples in an explicit sampler window. A successful lower RSS confirms the maximum at the new pass time; failed current RSS retains the maximum with its older real observation time.
Existing boot/PID/start-token identity separates instances. Restart resets sequence, CPU baseline and sampled-peak window, without mixing epochs.

implementationReview.area: Headless adaptive sampling, bounds, storage and fail-open execution
observations: One daemon lifecycle owner starts one native worker independently of GUI presence. Native-work, previous-CPU and latest-snapshot capacities are each one; no pending native-work queue accumulates.
The existing SQLite owner supplies one activity boolean from committed job/Traffic state. Measurement failure does not rewrite execution results, admission or permits.

Default idle/active/pressure intervals are 15,000/2,000/1,000 ms within 10-30 s and 1-3 s bounds. Completion-based scheduling avoids catch-up work and preserves an already published faster deadline during active-to-idle transitions.
Reads clone cached state without admitting work or renewing observation time. Shutdown retains ownership and joins the worker; timeout cannot admit a replacement.
Product resource persistence is zero: no resource-history table, queue or migration. SRS retention remains applicable if persistence is later introduced.

implementationReview.area: Dashboard, refresh ownership, accessibility, Credits and lifecycle

Meter freshness adds daemon sample age to local monotonic elapsed time and uses declared cadence independently of job/health freshness. Cached rereads cannot rejuvenate a sample; old peak/other field observations can become stale independently.
Failed/invalid/unsupported Meter reads preserve health/job refresh. Unsupported is reprobed on reconnect/manual refresh/reopen. Restart and late/retired replies do not carry old accounting forward.

Recorded outcomes, selection, focus, recent-page behavior, exact times and Credits remain covered. Hide/reopen and desktop-only quit keep their existing owners; headless sampling is separately evidenced.

Semantic groups/definition lists expose units, native/derived provenance, availability, exact times and full filesystem identity. Pressure has text labels. Numeric rows are outside live regions; deduplicated polite status announces transitions rather than every sample.
